_comment: STATIC SCHEMA/EXAMPLE TEMPLATE ONLY -- not a real, executable manifest and never read by any code path in this package (grep-verified). Real per-run manifests are always written by `raging_bolt_eval.py manifest --out PATH` to a caller-specified path outside this tracked allowlist; this file is never overwritten by that command. Same convention as profiles/outcome/pokemon-ai.example.json's status:example_only. `manifest` now RESOLVES opponents/games-per-segment itself (moved here from `run` -- see README.md's 'Design principle' section); this template's shape reflects that.

protocol_identity.decision_time_measurement: wall-clock time.perf_counter() around each agent's own decision call, tagged actor=a|b per decision; summarize filters to actor=a (the arm under measurement, since run always invokes head_to_head.py with the arm as --agent-a) before computing decision-time/observation-count cells; import/clone/engine-step/output-write time excluded

game_rng_control.reason: No seed/RNG-control parameter exists anywhere in cg.api/cg.game's Python surface (confirmed absence); whether the compiled libcg.so has internal RNG state beyond that surface is Unknown. This harness never claims seed control.

protocol_identity.illegal_action_rate_representation: Wilson score interval (same method as win/error/timeout rates); for any exact-zero or exact-n/n count the interval's bound on that side is never exactly 0 or 1 for finite n -- this holds under Wilson, Newcombe, or Clopper-Pearson alike and is a property of interval estimation, not a bug. Raw counts additionally reported as a non-normative diagnostic outside the Gatekeeper-shaped cell.

files: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_AT_RUNTIME -- one {name, sha256} entry per experiments/eval_infra/*.py source file

runtime_environment.os_distribution: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_AT_RUNTIME -- {availability, wsl_distro_name, os_release} when running under WSL/Linux, or {availability: NOT_APPLICABLE, reason} otherwise (e.g. on Windows)

measurement_settings.confidence_level: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_CALLER -- default 0.95, fixed HERE not at summarize time (see README.md BLOCKER 1)
measurement_settings.bootstrap_seed_scheme: sha256_counter(comparison_manifest_sha256, metric_id, segment_id, arm) -- no caller-supplied seed

selected_opponents: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_CALLER -- one fully-resolved binding per --opponent (see README.md), e.g. {"opponent_id":"mirror","source_kind":"self_play"} or a pinned_clone/local_only binding with individual per-file sha256
dataset_identity.league_complete: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_AT_RUNTIME -- true only if selected_opponents is a superset of {lucario, dragapult, megastarmie}

files: SET_BY_manifest_SUBCOMMAND_AT_RUNTIME -- individual {logical_name, path, sha256} entries (agent, deck, optional params), not a raw-byte-concatenation hash
